title: Tonight's Wind and Moon

outfit_card.silhouette: An ethereal high-waisted Xianxia silhouette featuring an empire-waist layered gown, detached sweeping floor-length open sleeves, and a split A-line skirt radiating flowing court elegance.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Filigree gold tiara featuring jade blossoms and pearls, complemented by dual flanking floral hairpins with dangling red beaded cord tassels.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Jade-green halter-neck brocade bodice framed with white fur collar trim, paired with voluminous detached ombre mint bell sleeves adorned with gilded embroidery and plush feathered cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multi-layered peach and ivory silk skirt with front slits, cinched by vermilion tasseled sashes suspending a carved jade medallion, worn over delicate strappy court slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Slender golden staff topped with a sculpted white swan, floral branches, and long floating silk streamers; stylized lotus and crane embroidery motifs throughout.
